[[Image:River Boern map.png|thumb|right|200px|Location]]
The '''River Boern''' is a river that flows through [[Ghealdan]]. It flows out of the [[Mountains of Mist]] and flows past [[Jehannah]] on its way to [[Boannda]], where it joins the [[River Eldar]] at the border of [[Amadicia]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Boern}}
